description: Official Prompt2CAD API SDK and examples for generating dimensioned CAD, modifying imported CAD/3D files, refining projects, selecting AI models and exporting geometry.
rules: Keep Prompt2CAD API keys server-side and read them from PROMPT2CAD_API_KEY.
Reuse the same idempotency key when retrying the same operation; use a new key for a new refinement.
Generation is asynchronous. Poll until completed before exporting or refining.
A paused generation requires an explicit resume; never automatically authorize another paid segment.
Use model default or deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash on generation requests; select it again on each new refinement.
STEP and IGES are not supported input formats. Use supported CAD uploads and cadFileIds.
